name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
It seems as if master had this planned from the start. I was not taught to create the items which you learned to create and you were not taught the items which I learned to create.

The master is wise, adventurer. We shall teach each other!

Show me how to make a mithril coif and ornate mithril shoulders and I shall show you how to create an ornate mithril helm.
narrative.objectives: Bring two Mithril Coifs and one Ornate Mithril Shoulder to Trenton Lighthammer.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! A fair tradeoff, if I do say so myself. Watch and learn, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you completed the crafting of the items, adventurer?
